title: Beyond a Single Sign: BiTE for Branch-Preserving Binary Threshold Expansion
abstract: arXiv:2611.17576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Binary neural networks (BNNs) reduce model storage and replace many arithmetic operations with efficient bitwise computations, but the single-sign activation limits their representational capacity. Each preactivation direction is compared with one threshold and reduced to one of two values, discarding variation within each sign region. We propose \textbf{BiTE} (Branch-Preserving Binary Threshold Expansion), which evaluates each feature direction against $K$ ordered thresholds and retains the resulting binary responses as separate inputs to the following learned operator. BiTE can distinguish up to $K+1$ ordered activation states while allowing the following operator to learn a separate transformation for each threshold response. It also enables a controllable trade-off between the number of independently constructed feature directions and the number of ordered responses extracted from each direction. translated_title: 超越单一符号：用于分支保留型二值阈值扩展的BiTE
translated_abstract: 二值神经网络（BNNs）通过减少模型存储量并用高效的按位运算替代许多算术运算来降低成本，但单一符号激活限制了其表示能力。每个预激活方向仅与一个阈值进行比较并被归约为两个值之一，从而丢弃了每个符号区域内部的变化。我们提出BiTE（分支保留型二值阈值扩展），它将每个特征方向与K个有序阈值进行比较，并将产生的二值响应保留为后续学习算子的独立输入。BiTE能够区分多达K+1个有序激活状态，同时允许后续算子为每个阈值响应学习单独的变换。它还实现了在独立构建的特征方向数量与从每个方向提取的有序响应数量之间的可控权衡。在BinaryViT上，BiTE提升了平均最终（准确率）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: BiTE通过将单一符号激活替换为K个有序阈值比较并保留分支响应，使二值神经网络能够区分多达K+1个有序激活状态，从而提升表示能力与准确率。
en_tdlr: BiTE replaces the single-sign activation with K ordered thresholds while preserving the resulting binary branches, enabling binary neural networks to distinguish up to K+1 ordered activation states and improving accuracy on BinaryViT.
